title: Calibration of Neuromusculoskeletal Models Using Differentiable Physics: Recommendations for Improving Model Accuracy
abstract: arXiv:2611.34428v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Differentiable physics has shown potential to usher in a new paradigm in human neuromusculoskeletal (NMS) model calibration. Early results from pioneering works have demonstrated that auto-differentiable NMS models can greatly reduce NMS model calibration time while achieving comparable accuracy compared to traditional calibration methods. The efficient gradient-based optimizers have enabled calibration of increasingly sophisticated human models with a large number of parameters, which seek to narrow the gap between simulation and reality. Several modules have been evaluated separately in different studies, but have never been directly compared within the same study. In this work, these modules are compared on the same differentiable upper limb model with a 3-DoF shoulder, a 2-DoF elbow, and 11 superficial and 5 deep muscles in the calibration to find an optimal pipeline for improving model accuracy. translated_abstract: 可微分物理有望为人体神经肌肉骨骼（NMS）模型校准带来一种新的范式。早期开创性研究的结果表明，自动可微分的NMS模型能够大幅缩短模型校准时间，同时达到与传统校准方法相当的精度。高效的基于梯度的优化器使得对参数众多、结构日益复杂的人体模型进行校准成为可能，从而缩小仿真与现实之间的差距。此前的研究已分别评估过若干模块，但从未在同一研究中对这些模块进行直接比较。在本工作中，这些模块在同一个可微分上肢模型上进行了比较，该模型包含3自由度肩关节、2自由度肘关节，以及11块浅层肌肉和5块深层肌肉参与校准，旨在寻找提高模型精度的最优校准流程。所考虑的模块包括肌肉……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究在同一个可微分上肢神经肌肉骨骼模型上系统比较了多种校准模块，给出了提升模型精度的最优校准流程建议。
en_tdlr: This study systematically compares calibration modules on the same differentiable upper-limb neuromusculoskeletal model and provides recommendations for an optimal pipeline to improve model accuracy.
